title: Signal: Apache Zeppelin console is reachable without authentication
scope: One response body whose document title names the Apache Zeppelin console.
limitations: One response body. The rule recognises the Apache Zeppelin console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Zeppelin</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>

Connecting to Zeppelin

Ask the platform team for access.

fpNotes: A documentation or marketing page whose title names Apache Zeppelin is reported; a page that only mentions the product in its body is not, because the rule reads the title element.
